title: Current Situation — draft form
description: A new cut, pre-populated with active bank accounts at balance 0 (Draft badge shown).

title: Current Situation — form filled
description: Balance and exchange rate entered, ready to save.

title: Save — no active period error
description: Saving fails with a 422 when no budget period covers the cut date yet.

title: Save — success
description: Success toast; the totals panel reflects the saved balances and exchange rate.

title: Delete cut — confirm dialog
description: Deletion requires typing the exact cut date to confirm — the button starts disabled.

title: Delete cut — date typed
description: Once the typed date matches, the delete button becomes enabled.

title: Delete cut — success
description: Cut record deleted; success toast shown.
